entries.title: jq recipe: combine multiple JSON files (union/merge)
entries.statement: Concatenate arrays: `jq -s 'add' file1.json file2.json` (treats top-level as arrays). Merge objects (later wins): `jq -s '.[0] * .[1]'`.
